POSE 1 (Top Left): ISSUE. Spine is unnaturally arched backward; legs are splayed without clear support.
POSE 2 (Top Middle): OK. Balanced seated twist; limbs are positioned naturally.
POSE 3 (Top Right): ISSUE. Spine is severely kinked; neck is craned at an impossible angle.
POSE 4 (Bottom Left): ISSUE. Legs are detached from the bench; spine is broken or floating.
POSE 5 (Bottom Middle): ISSUE. Feet are misaligned with the direction of travel; balance is off-center.
POSE 6 (Bottom Right): OK. Upright posture is stable; hands and feet are correctly placed.
